title: 拆锁路线的渐进收益与尾声
issue: 回指第 2 章 2.2.4“六年收尾”存疑项被本批新证翻案：Kris Kennaway 宣结邮件（freebsd-smp 列存档，2006-06）“Thanks to the hard work of many developers over the past ~6 years, this goal is now complete.”＋“We get to draw a line under the significant architectural changes of the past 6 years…6.x is the natural conclusion of that process”；Watson 论文另载“The FreeBSD SMPng Project, begun in June, 2000”——2000-06 至 2006-06 恰六年，两文互证；“渐进”面另有论文小节题“Slide Giant off Gradually”支撑

title: 无锁分区对 NUMA 的预适应
issue: 回指第 2 章已证（Hsu AsiaBSDCon 2004 论文，V52.2.5.2／V52.2.4.1／V52.2.4.2 三行同页可查）：“DragonFlyBSD starts out with a NUMA-centric view of the world”（正合题面“自始”）＋“resources are owned by a particular processor and messages passed to perform an operation on that resource”（按处理器组织资源）＋“implement lock-free scalability on symmetric as well as non-symmetric NUMA multiprocessors”（无锁分区与 NUMA 并举）；“预适应…支撑”为论证面

title: 大锁模型的保守代价
issue: 回指第 2 章已证（Asada 论文“We can preserve legacy code with this model, however it does not scale well compared to more recent implementations that are based on fine-grained lock models.”）＋本批新证 Watson 2005 论文逐字：“In a Giant lock kernel, a single spinlock is placed around the entire kernel”＋“when a process attempts to enter the kernel, even the process scheduler, it must acquire the Giant lock.”（正合“每次进入内核都取锁”）＋“maintains (with minimal modification) the synchronization model present in the uniprocessor kernel”（正合“旧代码可用”）＋“resulting in rapidly reduced scalability as the number of CPUs increases”（正合“核数增长后的放大”）

title: 三条路径的共同源头
issue: 回指第 2 章已证（Asada“OpenBSD employs a Big Giant Lock model”＋Hsu“The source base was forked off the RELENG_4 branch of FreeBSD on June 16, 2003”）＋本批新证 Watson 论文“The FreeBSD 3.x and 4.x kernel series make use of a Giant spinlock which ensures mutual exclusion whenever the kernel is running.”——拆锁（FreeBSD）、大锁（OpenBSD）、无锁分区（DragonFly，切自 RELENG_4）三条路径的单锁起点逐字在档；“分岔发生在第二步”为论证框架；⚠️若正文把“三条路径”扩含 NetBSD，其 BKL 起点尚无一手（NetBSD 5.0 公告只载改写后形态）

title: 线程模型选择对改造次序的制约
issue: 论证框架题，题面无独立外部事实断言；素材在档：FreeBSD 次序一手（Watson 论文 §3.4–3.9“新锁原语→调度锁→中断线程→数据锁→逐步卸 Giant”的次序叙述，本批实测：“Next, interrupt handlers are moved into ithreads, allowing them to execute as normal kernel threads”）；NetBSD“a rewritten threading subsystem based on a 1:1 threading model, new kernel synchronization primitives”与 OpenBSD“An rthread is a 1:1 native kernel thread library”两句回指第 2 章已证

title: 改造收尾时的残留项

title: Ports 树与 pkgsrc 的两种定位

title: 季度分支与滚动树的时间尺度

title: 预编译包对源码构建的替代
issue: 确证。本会话实测手册 Ports 章：“over 37000 third-party applications have already been ported to FreeBSD. When feasible, these applications are made available for download as pre-compiled packages.”；引言章另证“Over 30 thousand prebuilt packages for all supported architectures”（并回指第 4 章 4.4.1 已证 two complementary technologies 句）。精度注记：手册定位语为 complementary（并行双轨），题面“替代”宜作部署路径层面的替代解，不作排他性取代解。

title: 移植框架对异系统的吸附力
issue: 确证。本会话实测 pkgsrc 官网：“Code exists in pkgsrc to support 20+ Unix-like operating systems and 15+ CPU architectures.”——“二十余种系统”逐字命中（并回指第 4 章 4.4.6 已证）。“吸附力／生态外溢”为论题层推断，一手未载（同 4.4.3 口径），由正文批承担。

title: 基本系统与第三方件的边界
issue: 确证。本会话实测手册 Ports 章：“All supported versions of FreeBSD now contain /usr/sbin/pkg a.k.a pkg(7). This is a small placeholder that has just the minimum functionality required to install the real pkg(8).”（并回指第 4 章 4.4.5 已证 10.0R 发行注旧工具移除句）。口径注记：入基本系统者为 pkg(7) 占位符，pkg(8) 实体经 bootstrap 安装——题面“包管理工具入基本系统”宜按此分层表述。

title: 两种框架的体量对照
issue: 确证。本会话实测 pkgsrc 官网：“currently containing over 26,000 packages”——“逾 26000 包”逐字命中；FreeBSD 侧回指第 4 章 4.4.2 已证（引言章“There are about 37000 ports; the entire Ports Collection requires approximately 3 GB.”）。两数皆现页口径，正文宜注明统计时点。

title: 代码基线时点对路线的锁定
issue: 确证（回指第 4 章 4.3.3 已证）。Hsu《The DragonFly BSD Operating System》（AsiaBSDCon 2004）：“The source base was forked off the RELENG_4 branch of FreeBSD on June 16, 2003”——基线时点逐字在档；“锁定／长期效力”为论题层推断，无新增外部事实断言。

title: 自由可得在项目自述中的位置
issue: 确证（回指第 4 章 4.3.1 已证）。OpenBSD 官网：“The OpenBSD project produces a FREE, multi-platform 4.4BSD-based UNIX-like operating system.”并“OpenBSD is freely available from our download sites.”——FREE 大写居自述句首，“自由可得居自述首位”成立。

title: 人力规模对改造深度的限制
issue: 确证（回指第 4 章 4.3.5 已证）。Hsu 论文：“It is currently comprised of 16 committers with write privileges to the source repository and a community of outside contributors who submit bug patches and help with testing.”——规模基数在档；措辞 currently、论文收稿 2004-03，正文宜注时点；“决定可并行改造线数”为论题层推断。

title: 创始取向的长期投影
issue: 确证（回指第 4 章 4.1.5 已证）。NetBSD 官方史页：“NetBSD's original focus was quality and architecture independence. FreeBSD was formed later with a focus on the i386 PC platform.”——创始取向逐字在档；“长期投影／可追踪性”为论题层推断。

title: 相互借鉴与刻意分流的并存
issue: 确证（回指第 4 章已证）。互流腿：OpenZFS 官方 History“New OpenZFS features and fixes are regularly pulled in from illumos, to all ports to other platforms, and vice versa.”（4.8.5）——双向补丁流动逐字在档；分流腿：NetBSD 史页架构无关对 i386 取向对照（4.1.5）与 Dillon“too heavily mutexed”表态（4.3.4）。“并存”两腿俱有已证支撑。

title: 分化叙事的自我建构成分
issue: 确证（回指第 4 章 4.3.4 已证）。Hsu 论文“in place of the symmetric multiprocessing support being added to the upcoming FreeBSD 5 branch, DragonFlyBSD uses the concepts of partitioning and replication layered on top of a message passing system”与 Dillon 邮件“I considered starting with a 5.x base but it is simply too heavily mutexed”——以对立面定义自身的自述两独立源在档；“与史实的距离”为论题层论证，归正文批。

title: 五系共享的 UNIX 接口面
issue: 确证。本会话实测 DragonFly 官网：“belongs to the same class of operating systems as other BSD-derived systems and Linux. It is based on the same UNIX ideals and APIs”（后续句并及与其他 BSD 系统共享祖先代码）——第 7.6 节五系（DragonFly 与三 BSD 及 Linux）的共享接口面前提逐字命中。精度注记：系 DragonFly 单方自述，正文宜按自述口径落笔并注出处。

title: GNU 编码规范的成文形态
issue: 确证。本会话实测 GNU Coding Standards 正文页：“The GNU Coding Standards were written by Richard Stallman and other GNU Project volunteers.”并“Their purpose is to make the GNU system clean, consistent, and easy to install.”——“署名团队的成文规范”逐字命中；风格约束腿回指第 5 章 5.7.4 已验（Formatting 节“please use it consistently”句）。精度注记：题面对标对象为 GNU 规范（GNU/Linux 用户态一侧），Linux 内核侧另有其内核编码风格文档，节内宜明示取舍。

title: 许可差异对商业采用的影响
issue: 确证。本会话实测手册引言章：“Liberal Open Source license, which grants the rights to freely modify and extend its source code and incorporate it in both Open Source projects and closed products without imposing restrictions typical to copyleft licenses”——宽松许可容纳闭源并入逐字命中（第 4 章 4.8.6 已证同句）；“解释力与限度”为论题层论证。

title: 发行节奏的可比尺度
issue: 确证。本会话实测《FreeBSD Release Engineering》：“In between releases from the stable/ branches, approximately every two (2) years, a release will be cut directly from main.”——周期尺度逐字命中。精度注记：该两年周期专指自 main 切出的 dot-zero 大版，point release 自 stable/ 切出，两档节奏不可混写；“人力与流程双重约束／同类流程间可比”为论题层论证。

title: 发行公告中的云平台条目
issue: 确证。本会话实测 13.0R 公告：“FreeBSD 13.0-RELEASE amd64 is also available on these cloud hosting platforms:”（下列 amd64 与 arm64 的 EC2、GCE、Vagrant）；回指第 3 章 3.3.6 已证 14.0R 同句式条目（EC2、GCE、Azure、Vagrant）——跨版次同条目支撑“固定条目／常态”。精度注记：平台集合随版次变动（13.0R 无 Azure），宜写“条目固定、清单逐版变动”。

title: netmap 跨系统实现的既有范围
issue: 确证。本会话实测 USENIX ATC'12 netmap 摘要页：“netmap has been implemented in FreeBSD and Linux for several 1 and 10 Gbit/s network adapters.”——实现范围逐字命中（回指第 6 章 6.4.1／6.4.2 同页已证三项成本与 14.88 Mpps 句）。题面“结论限于该范围”与引句限定一致。
